scope: Read-only audit of existing benchmark/loop code and curated reports; CPU-only gate reproductions; no GPU jobs, source changes or performance claims.

current_evidence_assessment.existing_gpu_results: Useful exploratory component evidence with meaningful correctness checks; no finding here establishes fabricated results.
current_evidence_assessment.legacy_auto_promotion: Not sufficient for an adversarial or recursively self-modifying optimizer.
current_evidence_assessment.serving_3x: Not established; full-serving gate remains separate and unresolved.

strengths: Pinned SGLang commit and container digest.
Actual expert-method adapter instead of operation-count proxy.
Cloned preparation inputs and per-output reference checks.
AB/BA order balancing with raw samples.
Rejected candidates retained; initial failed control retained; no serving gain claimed from local score.

findings.title: Legacy summary gate is not an evidence validator
findings.observation: gate() trusts status, pairs and supplied confidence endpoints. Shape coverage uses set equality; duplicate rows are accepted. It does not check finite values, raw samples, candidate identity, correctness, or suite plan.
findings.consequence: A malformed, stale or optimizer-edited report can satisfy the apparent promotion gate without a measured improvement.
required_control: Require exactly one row per preregistered shape and exact suite coverage.
Require finite positive raw timings, even equal counts equal to declared pairs, finite ordered confidence endpoints.
Recompute summaries using an immutable evaluator and verify report/artifact identities.
Require structured, independently reviewed numerical and graph-lifetime correctness evidence bound to the same candidate and report.

local_cpu_reproduction.command: python3 importing benchmarks/optimize_loop.py gate; CPU only; no files modified
local_cpu_reproduction.interpretation: Gate bypass proof; not evidence that historical GPU reports were fabricated.

findings.title: Baseline source snapshot is not transitively frozen
findings.observation: Adapters freeze or retrieve the expert class source, but imports resolve through the current patched source tree and shared prepare helpers. The target anchor contains a class hash and commit, not a verified complete baseline dependency bundle.
findings.consequence: Future common-kernel or helper modifications can change both baseline and candidate, invalidating comparison against the original target even when the class hash stays fixed.
required_control: Freeze base commit + full patch + imported Python/CUDA headers + fixture/reference/harness/container/compiler identity.
Load baseline from an isolated immutable import tree/process or otherwise demonstrate module separation.
Treat baseline-current and baseline-goal as separate IDs; always retain a comparison against the original goal anchor.
Independent reviewer checks bundle completeness; a list of supplied hashes alone cannot prove that omitted dependencies were unchanged.

findings.title: Resume can reuse stale complete measurements
findings.observation: measure() returns an existing complete JSON without verifying candidate/source hash, seed, suite, pair count, harness version, or baseline identity. Queue snapshots can be overwritten while completed iterations are skipped by run_id.
findings.consequence: Changing a candidate or queue under the same run_id can attach old evidence to a new implementation.
required_control: Derive run identity from immutable proposal revision, candidate bundle, baseline bundle, plan, evaluator and seed.
Check evidence hashes on every transition and resume.
A candidate revision invalidates old review, measurement, validation and promotion decisions.
Append attempts instead of overwriting reports.

findings.title: Single-expert proxy cannot prove the serving objective
findings.observation: Measured scope is a synthetic single-rank expert method under CUDA graph replay. It excludes full model loading, pre-expert norm, collectives, scheduler, attention, draft acceptance, cache effects and response streaming.
findings.consequence: Neither local geometric mean nor one fast shape establishes 3x official serving throughput at stock interactivity or TTFT/output-agreement gates.
required_control: Keep local_validated/local_promoted distinct from serving_validated/goal_achieved.
Do not let RSI change the objective, denominator, workload, required loads, precision or output-agreement gates.
Require full-serving evidence on the prescribed topology before claiming serving speedup.

findings.title: Fixed visible seeds and adaptive selection are not durable holdouts
findings.observation: Screen and validation seeds are literal reusable values. Execution sweeps screen multiple policies on one seed. A candidate may win because any one target shape has a lower bound above 1.02; unadjusted intervals are exploratory.
findings.consequence: Repeated adaptive tuning can overfit shape/seed noise; multiple comparisons and repeated peeking increase false discoveries.
required_control: Preregister candidate family, target shapes, thresholds, sample sizes, stopping/retry rules and maximum trial count.
Freeze candidate before an independent validation seed/session allocation; consume validation data once and record it as exposed.
Run untouched acceptance seeds and representative distributions after screening; do not claim nominal familywise 95% confidence from per-shape CIs.
If formal simultaneous claims are needed, preregister a simultaneous bootstrap or multiplicity procedure instead of retroactively choosing a favorable test.

findings.title: Control retry was transparent but needs a general rule
findings.observation: Initial unchanged control at seed13001/pairs20 failed noninferiority because batch8 lower interval was 0.9703. A later seed14009/pairs60 control passed; original control is retained. This is consistent with an uncertainty-driven retry, not a demonstrated regression.
findings.consequence: Without a fixed escalation rule, future optimizer retries can become stop-when-significant selection.
required_control: Classify uncertain control separately from candidate regression.
Predeclare bounded sample escalation, e.g. 20 to 60 pairs once, before new candidate results are used.
Retain all attempts and choose whether escalation accumulates same-stream data or restarts independent sessions before observing results.
After a second failed control, investigate environment rather than changing thresholds or seeds repeatedly.

findings.title: Correctness is asserted but not structured into evidence
findings.observation: The GPU harness does meaningful reference checks including every timed output, skewed inputs, empty-local eager and captured replay. Results are mostly implicit in successful completion and stdout; report JSON lacks case-level outcomes and max errors.
findings.consequence: A future validator cannot independently establish which contracts were checked for a candidate solely from a summary report.
required_control: Record named case IDs, input/seed identities, dtype/shape, tolerances, max error and pass/fail.
Bind correctness to candidate dependency bundle and exact run/report hash.
Preserve NaN-in-ignored-slot, no-local-after-valid-replay, routing boundary, norm-order and lifetime tests.
Do not allow optimizer changes to weaken oracle, tolerance, precision, number of experts or model semantics.

findings.title: Timing protocol is useful but operational environment is incompletely recorded
findings.observation: Alternating AB/BA, fresh routing, cold-L2 eviction, preinitialized CUDA events, raw samples and separate profiling are sound local controls. Metadata omits UUID, driver, temperature/clocks/power, GPU owner, physical session ID and evaluator source hash.
findings.consequence: Within-run bootstrap cannot detect all session drift, contention or differences between local cold-cache conditions and serving behavior.
required_control: Record start/end host time, monotonic duration, GPU UUID and driver, container digest, clock/power/temperature telemetry, concurrent process snapshot and source bundle IDs.
Keep profiler traces outside clean timing; use separate physical/session repetitions for retained gains.
Treat cold-cache graph timing as a defined proxy; test realistic cache/shape sequences before serving claims.
Do not freeze clocks merely to improve a score; choose and disclose a reproducible clock policy.

findings.title: Locks are per-directory, not per physical GPU
findings.observation: Each runner locks its own result directory; different directories and direct benchmark commands can overlap. The profiler process check is a non-atomic check-then-start.
findings.consequence: Parallel agents can contaminate timing and exceed intended spend even when each local lock succeeds.
required_control: Use one host-level GPU UUID lease shared by benchmarks, profiler and all agents.
Lease acquisition must be atomic and include owner, run ID, PID/container identity and generation nonce.
Do not expire/reclaim a lease from elapsed time alone; verify actual process/container termination.
Keep source editing/review parallel; serialize all GPU measurement/profile jobs.

findings.title: Timeout is not complete process or billing containment
findings.observation: Deadlines cover a runner subprocess; preflight occurs before the timer. Timeout kills the direct child but does not establish that compiler descendants or the Docker container are gone. Idle rented-node time remains billed.
findings.consequence: A session-minute label is not a hard node-spend cap and terminal ledger state may outlive active descendants.
required_control: Track actual container/process-group handles and verify exit before releasing GPU ownership.
Bound compile, preflight, correctness, measurement, profile and validation phases; include them in cost accounting.
Record actual elapsed node time and explicit rate assumption; distinguish estimated compute cost from provider invoice.
Never automatically destroy the node unless user authorization covers that operation.

findings.title: Ledger labels are process controls, not authentication
findings.observation: All agents share a writable workspace. A reviewer string, evidence manifest or file hash is not by itself proof of independent authorship or protection against evaluator edits.
findings.consequence: An unconstrained self-improver could write both proposal and approval or replace the evaluator and rehash it.
required_control: Root orchestrator records actual author/reviewer agent IDs and message/artifact hashes; reject self-review.
Pin evaluator/goal policy outside the optimizer-owned change set and require independent approval for evaluator changes.
Document shared-filesystem trust assumptions; do not claim a security boundary the implementation does not enforce.
Treat any optimizer-method change as a separate experiment with its own held-out evaluation.

proposal: Immutable objective and original baseline ID
Exact primary/regression suite and allowed shape guards
Expected gain and uncertainty labeled as prior
before_run: Candidate and baseline imports demonstrably isolated
Control test passes preregistered equivalence/noninferiority gate
measurement: Finite positive paired raw samples with even counts
Structured correctness evidence for same candidate
validation: Candidate frozen before new seed/session allocation
At least two independent validation allocations; seeds distinct from selection data
Full primary+regression suite, precision contracts, realistic boundary/distribution tests
Independent reviewer inspects artifacts and source
goal_completion: Exact official serving scope and topology
TTFT and stock-interactivity throughput at every required load
Predeclared aggregate target >=3x current goal anchor with adequate repeated evidence
Independent completion audit; local speedup cannot substitute

optimizer_self_improvement_protocol.separation: Kernel candidates change implementation; optimizer candidates change ranking, hypothesis generation, experiment design or orchestration. Neither changes acceptance policy or target.
offline_screen: Version an immutable historical task corpus. Split by optimization family, not individual timing rows, to avoid near-duplicate leakage.
Use only training families to tune ranking/calibration. Freeze the optimizer policy before exposing evaluation-family outcomes.
Replay fixed per-task engineering/GPU costs and outcomes to compare selection order under equal budgets; label this historical replay, not new kernel improvement.
Track exposed task/seed/family IDs; replace evaluation sets once they become development data.
online_validation: Preregister baseline optimizer and challenger, equal resource budgets, fixed evaluator and candidate acceptance rules.
Use independent future task families and seeds; interleave serial GPU sessions to reduce environment/time confounding.
All challenger-produced code still passes the same kernel correctness/holdout/serving gates.
Retain all failures, compilation costs, rejected candidates, control retries and idle/setup costs.
No promotion based on number of trials, attractive proposals, shorter tests or relaxed checks.

metrics.primary: Validated improvement against frozen goal anchor per total authorized resource cost, with all-shape regressions constrained.
secondary: Time to first independently validated gain
Fraction of predicted wins that validate
Wasted GPU time on invalid or duplicate experiments
metrics.accounting: Report engineering/agent time, GPU-active/compile time and node elapsed dollars separately; any combined scalar weighting must be fixed before comparison.

optimizer_self_improvement_protocol.independence_limit: Shared-agent filesystem and role separation are procedural. Strong hidden evaluation requires external access control or an evaluator service not editable/readable by the optimizer.
optimizer_self_improvement_protocol.promotion_rule: Independent reviewer accepts an optimizer revision only if it improves held-out optimization outcomes at equal budgets without weakening kernel/serving gates.

immediate_actions_ranked: Make new RSI evidence ingestion fail closed on raw-sample/schema/provenance gaps; legacy reports remain research evidence.
Freeze full baseline/evaluator bundles and exact experiment plans; invalidate evidence on any revision.
Install one GPU lease across all agents and runners with verified process termination.
Add structured correctness and environment/session metadata to new benchmark reports.
Predeclare control sample escalation and new holdout allocations before future tuning.
Evaluate optimizer changes on held-out task families with fixed cost/acceptance policy.
